# Movies Wrapped

> Movies Wrapped is a free, independent web app that turns a Letterboxd data export into a personal film dossier: statistics, rating personality, directors, actors, review analysis, and a cinema-scale score. It is not the official Letterboxd Wrapped. No Movies Wrapped account is required.

## Start here

- [Movies Wrapped](https://movieswrapped.com/en): Upload a Letterboxd export and open your dossier.
- [Movies Wrapped (Türkçe)](https://movieswrapped.com/tr): Aynı araç, Türkçe arayüz.

## Guides

- [Letterboxd Wrapped explained](https://movieswrapped.com/en/letterboxd-wrapped): How the official January recap works, and how Movies Wrapped differs.
- [Letterboxd Wrapped açıklaması](https://movieswrapped.com/tr/letterboxd-wrapped): Resmi Ocak özeti ile Movies Wrapped arasındaki fark.
- [Export your Letterboxd data](https://movieswrapped.com/en/export-letterboxd-data): Settings → Data → Export Your Data, then upload the ZIP.
- [Letterboxd verisini dışa aktarma](https://movieswrapped.com/tr/export-letterboxd-data): Settings → Data → Export Your Data, sonra ZIP yükleme.
- [Cinema scale](https://movieswrapped.com/en/cinema-scale): What the 0–100 cine_v2 score measures. Popularity is not included.
- [Sinema ölçeği](https://movieswrapped.com/tr/cinema-scale): 0–100 cine_v2 puanının neyi ölçtüğü. Popülerlik puana girmez.

## Optional

- [Full text for answer engines](https://movieswrapped.com/llms-full.txt): The English guide text in one file.

## Key facts

- Free. No Movies Wrapped account. Reliable input is the Letterboxd ZIP, or the CSVs inside it, from https://letterboxd.com/settings/data/.
- Official Letterboxd year-in-review: Letterboxd’s help center says emails go out on January 2, a personalized email needs 10 diary logs that year, and in the app it is Profile → Stats → Summaries. On the web: https://letterboxd.com/yir/.
- Personal results pages (/results, /en/results, /tr/results) and the story player (/en/story, /tr/story) are not documents for search. robots.txt disallows the results paths.
- Cinema scale model: cine_v2. Axes: geography, time, languages, volume, genres, directors. TMDB popularity is not part of the score.
